title: Dispatch From Horse Nation
author: Alyse Burnside
content:
Photograph by Joeyln Dalit. Joelyn and I talked through the bars on the stall
windows as we shoveled manure into large buckets. We had gotten to know each
other one Saturday morning after another, swapping stories while hoisting
heavy buckets of horse shit into a small John Deere tractor at the barn where
I worked […]
